subject: Discovery recap: Dedicated capacity fit - Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: Dedicated capacity fit - Nimbus Health

Hi Sam / Aisha -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the next steps we discussed so we stay aligned. I wanted to capture the pain, goals, and an early checklist for a Dedicated capacity pilot.

Key pain points you shared:
- Latency spikes during peak hours (esp. during admissions batch window) causing degraded UX for clinicians.
- Cost unpredictability with current self-hosted approach and frequent cold-starts.
- Security/isolation requirement: PHI must not mix with other tenants; strict audit logging required.

Current stack / constraints:
- Running inference on AWS EKS with mixed CPU/GPU nodes; using an open LLM (quantized) in-house.
- Average request size ~15 tokens, but a long tail up to 120 tokens for note summarization.
- Traffic pattern: baseline ~200 reqs/minute, spikes to ~1,000 reqs/minute for 10-15 minutes, predictable windows around 2-3pm PT.

Success criteria for a Dedicated fit:
1) Predictable throughput: sustain the 1,000 reqs/minute spike with <150ms p95 per token for 15-token requests.
2) Strong isolation: VPC/private deployment or dedicated GPU pools; audit logs for every request.
3) Autoscaling/burst: ability to autoscale to 4-5x baseline in under ~90s during spike windows, with defined burst capacity.
4) Cost target: lower total per-token cost than current infra + ops overhead (we'll propose concrete numbers).

Initial next steps (owners & timing):
- I will share a preliminary sizing workbook and a draft SOW for a 6-week POC (attached). (vanessa) - by EOD Thu 6/11
- Your team to share the security questionnaire + any required compliance docs (Aisha) - by Mon 6/15
- Align on POC success metrics and kickoff date; aiming for week of 6/22 for POC start. (both)

Attachments: nimbus_health_capacity_calc.xlsx (prelim sizing)

If I missed anything, flag it - otherwise I'll iterate on sizing and get a draft SOW over tomorrow.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@nimbushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Reddy <aisha.reddy@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Dedicated capacity fit - Nimbus Health

Thanks Vanessa - this looks great and aligned with our notes. A couple quick clarifications:

- Traffic math: our spike is roughly 1,000 requests/minute for 10-15 minutes (not sustained), but some workflows (batch note generation) will hit sustained runs of ~200-300 reqs/min for 30-45 minutes.
- Target latency: prefer p95 < 200ms per request (for our UX) - I know you called out per-token; we can convert once you share the sizing sheet.
- Security: we need encryption at rest + in-transit, customer-managed KMS for keys, and SOC2 evidence. We can share the security questionnaire by 6/15.

We'd like to scope the POC to a single critical workflow (admission notes) and validate scale + isolation. If you can propose a POC plan and a rough cost for Dedicated 4-week pilot vs. 6-week pilot, that would be helpful.

Appreciate it - Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Engineering - Integrations

Hi Sam - great, thanks for the clarifications - very helpful. Attaching an updated sizing workbook (capacity_calc_v2.xlsx) and a draft SOW for the Dedicated POC (draft_sow_nimbus_dedicated.pdf).

Quick notes on the ask/answers based on your clarifications:
- We'll present both per-token and per-request latency projections in the sizing. For your UX target we can map 15 tokens/request to a ~150-180ms p95 target on the proposed GPU profile; we'll include a margin for longer requests.
- Autoscale & burst: proposal will include a reserved GPU pool sized for baseline traffic + an autoscale policy that can add burst capacity (pre-warmed slots) to cover the 4-5x spikes within ~60-90s.
- Isolation & security: Dedicated pools + VPC peering and customer-managed KMS supported; Rafael will own SOC2 evidence pack and infra onboarding details.

Proposed next steps:
1) You (Nimbus) share completed security questionnaire + any compliance docs (due 6/15).
2) We finalize SOW and pilot plan - I'll send a revised SOW by EOD 6/11.
3) POC kickoff week of 6/22 if timeline works for you - plan: 1-week install & validation, 3-week load/scale tests, 2-week tuning (6-week POC).

- Security: customer-managed KMS, SOC2 evidence requested, VPC peering required.

Immediate asks:
